section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) that investigated the psychometric properties of a Brazilian Portuguese translation of the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS). The study involved 194 Brazilian university women. Findings indicated adequate convergent validity and that breast size dissatisfaction is prevalent among Brazilian women.
